If you need to change the address after this period, you must cancel the order and place a new one, subject to our cancellation policy.

If the requested variant is out of stock, we will offer a 10% discount on the next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and expires after 30 days if not used.

3. Upgrading your shipping method from Standard to Express incurs an additional fee of $15.00. This fee is calculated based on the difference in carrier rates. If you downgrade from Express to Standard, we will refund the difference, which is typically between $5.00 and $12.00, within 5 business days of the change request.

- Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if you cancel after the order status becomes "Processing."

You have 48 hours to retrieve the item from the local depot. If you fail to collect it within this timeframe, the item is considered returned, and the return process begins immediately.
6. We do not accept returns on custom-configured bikes or personalized gear. These items are made to order and cannot be resold. I know that's frustrating, and I wish I could offer a different outcome here. If there's anything else I can help with, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Warm regards,
Rivertown Cycles Support
